rules.expected: Use source23 observations plus two clogged missing positions; preserve trace/n.d./dash without invented thresholds. State how post-quench yields, recovery, dilution and time/temperature definitions enter the analysis. Recompute data transformations from source rows and code. Score only the part supported by valid artifacts: full credit for a sufficient valid argument within scope; partial credit for a correct but incomplete evidential chain; no credit for assertions, wrong objects/references or missing decisive evidence. scoring_notes: No frozen new reference number or tolerance. Numerical agreement alone is not the criterion.
Scientific validity and raw-artifact linkage must be inspected; schema only checks format.
Missing author/V1 pathway is not a failure when the chosen evidence is adequate.
The source paper and legacy snapshots are conditional reference evidence, not a required answer.
Partial-credit boundaries are rule-specific; no-evidence uncertainty does not establish non-identifiability.
